root_cause.text: The `parse_dacl()` function in the CIFS client assumes that a SID matching `sid_unix_NFS_mode` always has at least three subauthorities and dereferences `sid.sub_auth[2]` without checking `num_subauth`, while `compare_sids()` only compares up to the minimum of the two SIDs' subauthority counts, allowing a malicious server to supply a crafted SID with fewer subauthorities that still matches and triggers an out-of-bounds read.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `ppace[i]->sid.num_subauth >= 3` before the `compare_sids()` check, preventing the out-of-bounds access. The CVE description explains that `compare_sids()` only compares `min(a, b)` subauthorities, so a SID with `num_subauth = 2` and `sub_auth[] = {88, 3}` matches `sid_unix_NFS_mode` and then reads `sub_auth[2]` four bytes past the end of the ACE.
